recognize_zh: 高倍脾臟切片中滿布大型組織球，細胞質淡染並充滿細小空泡、呈泡沫或網狀，核小而位於中央或偏位，細胞邊界清楚，是 Niemann-Pick 病典型的泡沫細胞。
features: Sheets of large polygonal histiocytes with sharply defined cell borders
Abundant pale cytoplasm filled with fine clear vacuoles (foamy/bubbly)
Small, round, dark nuclei, central or eccentric, low N:C ratio
Occasional faint granular material within the vacuolated cytoplasm
Scattered small lymphocytes and red cells between storage cells
describe_en: High-power section of spleen shows sheets of large polygonal histiocytes with sharply defined borders and abundant pale cytoplasm distended by fine, uniform clear vacuoles, imparting a foamy appearance. Nuclei are small, round, and bland. Scattered small lymphocytes and red cells lie between the storage cells. Findings are consistent with lipid-laden foam cells of Niemann-Pick disease involving the spleen.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have eosinophilic striated 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than clear bubbly vacuoles.
Hairy cells are smaller lymphoid cells with oval/bean-shaped nuclei and clear cytoplasm halos, and are B-cell marker positive.
Infected histiocytes contain acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain, which is negative in storage disease.
Clear cell carcinoma is cohesive with atypical nuclei and is keratin positive, whereas these cells have bland small nuclei and are CD68 positive.
